title: Wang2025: Four-class motor imagery dataset (ZJU-MI-EEG / MI4)
description: A four-class motor imagery EEG dataset (ZJU-MI-EEG / MI4) recorded from 15 healthy participants performing cued imagery of left hand, right hand, tongue, and both feet movements. Data were acquired with 62 EEG channels at 256 Hz over two days, each including a calibration run and an online visual-feedback run. This BIDS re-release was generated via MOABB for brain-computer interface research and benchmarking.
methods_description: Participants performed cued four-class motor imagery (left hand, right hand, tongue, both feet) over two sessions. Each session had a 240-trial calibration run and a 160-trial online feedback run, with 4 s trials and visual feedback. EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (62 channels, 10-10 montage, 256 Hz, 0.1 Hz online high-pass, 50 Hz line frequency).
